st.headline: Asian stocks edge higher as oil drops on fresh Mid-East hopes
st.teaser: Asian stocks edge higher as oil drops on fresh Mid-East hopes
fullText: HONG KONG - Asian stocks edged higher on Aug 26 as oil prices extended a decline on receding concerns about another military flare-up between the United States and Iran, while traders were also nervously awaiting Nvidia’s earnings and key US inflation data.

Both main crude contracts have tumbled more than 8 per cent this week as Tehran and Oman edge towards a deal to partially reopen the Strait of Hormuz , while signs of fresh diplomacy to end the Middle East crisis added to the upbeat mood.
While US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the White House was declaring an “economic D-Day” against Iran and its trade partners, the measures were regarded as softer than many had feared.

BNZ’s Jason Wong wrote: “The move could reflect market sentiment that the latest US strategy, ‘Operation Economic Outcast’, aimed at severing Iran’s remaining financial lifelines, could bring Iran back to the negotiating table and help resolve the conflict.”
The comments came as key Pakistani mediators reported positive talks with Iran’s president on Aug 24.

Pakistan Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi reported “a very positive and productive meeting”, saying on X he believes the “momentum will help pave the way for further progress and lasting peace in the region”.
Crude fell more than 2 per cent on Aug 26, with Brent back well below US$90 a barrel.
That has eased pressure on markets after last week’s spike fanned inflation fears and sent the yield on long-dated US Treasuries to their highest since 2007, just before the global financial crisis.
The cost of US borrowing easing and the prospect of more Middle East talks provided a much-needed boost to equities.
Tokyo, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Sydney, Seoul, Wellington and Taipei all rose, though Singapore and Manila fell.
However, analysts said the simmering US-Canada trade row was causing some uncertainty, while the big event on the agenda this week is Nvidia’s second-quarter earnings on Aug 26.
The chipmaking titan has become a key marker of the reporting season as investors use it to judge the health of the AI boom that has sent markets to record highs over the past two years.
The figures come during rising angst about when the vast sums of cash pumped into AI software and hardware will see a meaningful return, if ever.
“Several analysts argue that the second-quarter number itself may end up mattering less than what management says about the quarter ahead,” said Axel Rudolph, a market analyst at IG.
“It’s entirely possible for the headline print to look solid and the stock to still sell off if the third-quarter guide comes in below what’s already embedded in current estimates.

“Conversely, even a modest second-quarter beat could support the stock if management raises the forward outlook and reiterates that supply, rather than softening customer demand, remains the binding constraint.”

Aug 26 also sees the release of US personal consumption expenditure data, the Federal Reserve’s favoured gauge of inflation that could play a role in policymakers’ decision-making with regard to interest rates.
A soft reading could temper hike worries but an outsized figure would likely ramp up bets on an increase in borrowing costs. AFP

cna.headline: Japan to diversify crude supplies, back Mideast pipelines in resilience effort, media say
cna.teaser: Japan to diversify crude supplies, back Mideast pipelines in resilience effort, media say
fullText: TOKYO, Aug 26 : Japan is set to unveil on Wednesday a comprehensive plan to boost resilience of its energy supply, with steps such as diversifying crude oil procurement and supporting Middle East pipelines to bypass the Strait of Hormuz, media said.
The plan will be outlined at a meeting of the government's Green Transformation (GX) Implementation Council, Kyodo news agency said.

• Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi set an end of August deadline for preparation of a package to beef up energy resilience after the Iran war and the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz highlighted Japan's heavy reliance on Middle Eastern crude.
• On Tuesday Industry Minister Ryosei Akazawa said the plan featured measures to cut dependence on supplies through the Strait of Hormuz, as well as bolster non-fossil fuel energy supplies.
• Japan will also cooperate with Middle Eastern countries on pipeline projects to bypass the strait through the Japan Organization for Metals and Energy Security (JOGMEC), Kyodo and Nikkei said.

• The plan also aims to build strategic stockpiles of naphtha, Kyodo said, after shortages of the petrochemical feedstock, used in plastics and printing inks, forced some companies to suspend sales or simplify packaging.
• The industry ministry, which was charged with drafting the plan, was not immediately available for comment.
• Middle East imports supplied 94 per cent of Japan's crude oil in 2025, with 93 per cent going through the Strait.

listening.title: Powering up Singapore's Heartland EVs
listening.transcript: As Singapore steers towards a cleaner transport landscape, the rollout of electric vehicle charging points in public housing estates is gathering pace. Residents in estates like Jurong and Yishun can now easily plug in overnight. This infrastructure drive aims to eliminate range anxiety among prospective car buyers. By 2030, the government plans to install sixty thousand charging points islandwide, fundamentally shifting the city's relationship with private transport.

economistArticle.title: What makes a great investor?
paras: We often picture legendary investors as brilliant, mathematically precise geniuses who decode the market's inner workings. Yet, empirical evidence suggests that stellar returns are frequently the byproduct of blind luck masquerading as genius. The line between a visionary bet and a reckless gamble is remarkably thin, and financial history is written by the survivors who happened to flip heads ten times in a row.

Beyond mere serendipity, those who consistently beat the market often possess a distinctly odd character. They are not well-rounded team players who excel in corporate boardrooms. Instead, they exhibit an almost pathological level of detachment, emotional insulation, and contrarian obstinacy. They do not feel the social pressure to conform to market consensus, allowing them to buy when others panic.

This temperament is highly idiosyncratic. Take the legendary figures of value investing, who hold onto plummeting stocks with an equanimity that verges on the inhuman. While the average retail investor panics during a downturn, these individuals view market turbulence as a mere statistical fluctuation. They lack the biological urge to run with the herd, a trait that would make them terrible party guests but outstanding allocators of capital.

Moreover, great investors are comfortable with cognitive dissonance. They can hold two opposing views simultaneously, waiting for the market to reveal which reality will manifest. This intellectual flexibility, paired with absolute conviction once a decision is made, is a rare psychological cocktail. It is a state of mind that borders on obsessive, where information is dissected with clinical coldness.

Ultimately, trying to replicate their success by merely copying their strategies is a fool's errand. One can mimic their portfolio allocation, but one cannot easily synthesize their eccentric personality or purchase the sheer luck that crowns a market king. In the financial casino, the house always wins, unless you happen to be a statistical anomaly with a delightfully peculiar brain.
economistArticle.cn:
我们常常把传奇投资人想象成聪明绝顶、数学功底深厚的奇才，能够破解市场运行的奥秘。然而，经验证据表明，优异的投资回报往往只是盲目的运气伪装成了天才。远见卓识的豪赌与不计后果的投机之间，界限极其微妙，而金融历史是由那些恰好连续十次掷出正面并幸存下来的赢家谱写的。
除了机缘巧合，那些能够持续战胜市场的人，往往拥有一种极为古怪的性格。他们绝不是在企业董事会中长袖善舞、八面玲珑的团队合作者。相反，他们表现出一种几近病态的超然、情感隔离和逆向思维的执拗。他们感受不到顺应市场共识的社会压力，这使他们能够在他人恐慌时买入。
这种性格特质极其独特。以价值投资领域的传奇人物为例，他们以一种近乎冷血的镇定紧握暴跌的股票。当普通散户在股市低迷中恐慌时，这些人却将市场动荡视作单纯的统计波动。他们缺乏随波逐流的本能——这种特质可能会让他们在派对上大煞风景，却能让他们成为极其出色的资本配置者。
此外，优秀的投资人往往能够泰然处之于认知失调。他们能同时持有两种相反的观点，等待市场揭示哪一种现实将会胜出。这种思想上的灵活性，加上一旦做出决定后的绝对信念，构成了一种罕见的心理鸡尾酒。这是一种近乎执念的精神状态，信息在这里被以临床般的冷酷进行剖析。
归根结底，仅仅通过复制其投资策略来复制其成功是徒劳的。人们可以模仿他们的投资组合配置，却无法轻易复制那种古怪的个性，也无法买到加冕市场之王所需的绝对运气。在金融赌场里，赢家总是庄家，除非你恰好是一个拥有奇特大脑的统计学异类。

gems.s: The line between a visionary bet and a reckless gamble is remarkably thin, and financial history is written by the survivors who happened to flip heads ten times in a row.
gems.why: This sentence employs a vivid metaphor ('flip heads ten times in a row') and an elegant contrast between 'visionary bet' and 'reckless gamble' to brilliantly deconstruct the myth of the financial genius. 这句话运用了生动的比喻（‘连续十次掷出正面’）以及‘远见卓识的豪赌’与‘不计后果的投机’之间的优雅对比，极其精彩地解构了金融天才的神话。
